Avedon Is a Gracefully Constructed Documentary About a Great American Photographer

Richard Avedon , whose career began in the early 1940s and ended with his death, following a cerebral hemorrhage, in 2004, was one of the greatest fashion photographers of his era. Even if you think you don’t care about fashion, you’ve probably been awed by his 1955 Dovima With Elephants, in which the supermodel Dovima, draped in a two-tone Dior gown, stands regally between two pachyderms, her arms outstretched as if to read their magnificence with her fingertips. …
